definition: the months each year when school is open
description: An old stone university building on a bright autumn morning. A man in a navy suit pulls open the big wooden doors at the top of the steps. A smiling young woman in a mustard cardigan and jeans, with a green backpack and books in her arms, runs up the stone steps, followed by a young man in a blue jumper with a backpack. At the top all three stand by the open doors, smiling and laughing. Orange and red leaves lie on the steps, and bicycles stand by the wall.

en.question: What is the young woman holding?

es.answer: Está abrazando un montón de libros.
